title: The Genome Atlas's engine and genomes
about: The genomics and evolution domains' C++ with morphe and calx, compiled once with g++ 11 or later (natively or in WSL, -O3 -march=native) into data/cache/engines/genome/, about two minutes; and fourteen reference genomes from NCBI RefSeq (12 MB): two phages, SARS-CoV-2, Escherichia coli K-12 and ten primate mitochondria.
